name: Hollow World-Wound Behemoth
loreTies: A massive mobile Gate wound used for seasonal Hollow Breach events; it is not summoned, it arrives where too many victories leave unburied memory.
Seasonal world boss that changes terrain, spawns anchors, and tests multiple active divine archetypes.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow World-Wound Behemoth is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into world boss battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow World-Wound Behemoth formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Titan, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Seasonal world boss that changes terrain, spawns anchors, and tests multiple active divine archetypes. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A massive mobile Gate wound used for seasonal Hollow Breach events; it is not summoned, it arrives where too many victories leave unburied memory.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow World-Wound Behemoth can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow World-Wound Behemoth visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses colossal negative-space beast with gate arches as ribs, cities of ash under translucent hide, maskless skull horizon, white storm fractures. while its abilities — Walk the Breach, Erase the Ground, Call the Nameless Storm — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Titan.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
